name: 鲁达赫
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:2055
who: Rudah, called Wall-Burster, a fire-horned demon war-chief of the tents beyond the middle wall, ninety-odd years old but looking about forty-five: about 198 cm, huge and heavy-boned. Dark red-brown skin like cooling iron. Two long horns sweeping backward at a slant, flame on their tips, banked to a charcoal red at rest. The left half of his face, from the temple down to the jaw, is a hard red crust of skin that once melted and set again (his left, on the viewer's right when he faces us). Long sulphur-yellow hair held back at the nape by a plain iron ring, its ends scorched black. Eyes the orange-red of a coal's heart. He carries a broad-backed chopping blade, its spine crusted with black slag. A blunt, hungry, short-worded air of a man who thinks first of water and bread.
face: FACE, as in the references: a heavy, harsh man's face of about forty-five: deep-set orange-red eyes under thick brows, a broad nose, a hard closed mouth; dark red-brown skin; the left half of the face, from the temple to the jaw, covered by a rough glossy red crust of once-melted skin with cracked edges (his left, on the viewer's right when he faces us), the right half whole and lined at the eye; long horns sweeping backward at a slant with banked charcoal-red flame on the tips.
build: 198 cm, huge and heavy-boned: massive shoulders and back, a deep chest, thick arms and big scarred hands.
palette: charcoal red and slag black, sulphur yellow, dark red-brown, scorched leather
casual: His camp clothes beyond the wall: a heavy sleeveless coat of scorched dark leather laced at the sides over a long-sleeved coarse wool shirt, a wide belt with a hide water skin, heavy trousers wrapped at the shins and thick boots, a ragged fur cape on the shoulders. In his right hand the broad-backed chopping blade, its spine black with slag, held low. He stands heavy and still, a flat, weighing look.
private: Among his tents, handing out water: the fur cape and the leather coat off, the coarse wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up, the heavy trousers and boots, the hair loose of its ring. He holds a large hide water skin in both hands, a tired, grim, careful look.
battle: At the foot of a wall tower, in a fire-horn war-chief's harness: heavy plates of black obsidian-glazed iron over thick scorched leather strapped across his chest and shoulders, their edges glowing a sullen ember red, iron-studded bracers ringed with obsidian, a broad belt set with ember-bright iron studs, the fur cape torn away, the hair bound tight in its iron ring. Both backswept horns burn a blinding orange-white from root to tip; he grips the slag-crusted broad-backed blade in his right hand, molten light running along its black spine, and leans forward, head lowered to drive the horns in. A savage, set look.
formal: Standing in the oath ring before his people: a long coat of dark red-brown hide to the knee, laced at the front with thongs, the hem edged with scorched black fur, a broad belt of iron plates, a heavy torque of black obsidian at the neck, the horn flames burning low and steady. He stands with the broad-backed blade planted point-down before him, both hands on the hilt, a hard, grave look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the camera tilted, the orange-red eyes looking straight at the viewer, the crusted left half of his face lit by his own horn fire, a heavy, unblinking look, the mouth closed. Fierce orange-white light from the horn tips above, cold blue-grey dusk from the other side. Foreground blur: rising steam and the slag-crusted spine of the blade. He wears the scorched leather coat and fur cape.
battle_old: At the foot of a wall tower: plates of blackened iron and thick boiled leather strapped over his chest and shoulders, iron-studded bracers, the fur cape torn away, the hair bound tight in its iron ring. Both backswept horns burn a blinding orange-white from root to tip; he grips the slag-crusted broad-backed blade in his right hand and leans forward, head lowered to drive the horns in. A savage, set look.
gear: 英雄（冠名那一截以下）｜中｜照常｜4档｜英雄定4，几万顶帐子的炎角战头；照灯的年月炎角的样子，黑铁加黑曜的胸肩甲，招牌是燃白的双角和结渣的宽背砍刀。

name: 阿涅洛·灰秤
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:2081
who: Anello Greyscale, a human head warden of a southern wall prison above a water gate, forty-eight years old: about 176 cm, square and solid. Curly deep ink-blue hair cut short above the ears. Olive-green eyes. His right eyebrow is cut in two by an old scar (his right, on the viewer's left when he faces us). At his belt hang a ring of prison keys and a small brass steelyard as long as his hand, a fire-warped shield buckle hanging from its beam, his younger brother's. No jewellery, no glasses. A plain, exact, weighing air; he weighs everything that comes into his hand.
face: FACE, as in the references: a square, plain man's face of forty-eight, NOT young: olive-green eyes under thick ink-blue brows, the right brow cut in two by a short pale scar (his right, on the viewer's left when he faces us); lines across the brow and at the eye corners, a deep line beside the mouth; a broad nose; a firm closed mouth; clean-shaven with a faint shadow of stubble. Skin shadows a cool, pale tone.
build: 176 cm, square and solid: broad shoulders, a thick neck, strong forearms.
palette: ink blue and olive green, brass, undyed wool grey, iron black
casual: His warden's clothes in the wall-garrison years: a faded long garrison coat of undyed grey wool, patched at the cuffs, closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, over a brown leather jerkin, dark trousers and heavy boots; a broad belt from which hang a ring of iron keys and the small brass steelyard with the warped shield buckle on its beam. He holds a round loaf of bread in one hand as if weighing it, a level, exact look.
private: Carrying warmth down the cold prison passage: the coat off, a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt with a knitted grey vest, the belt with the keys and the brass steelyard, the trousers and boots. He holds a small iron brazier of glowing charcoal by its two handles in front of him, a gruff, careful look.
battle: On the night of the water gate, in a prison warden's kit: the leather jerkin buckled tight under the grey garrison coat, a riveted iron breast plate over the jerkin with a short row of small angular runes cut across the plate glowing faintly white, NO cross, NO star or ray shape, a steel gorget, leather bracers, the ring of keys and the brass steelyard with its warped shield buckle at the belt. In his left hand he holds up a blessed lamp, an iron-framed lantern with a clear pale white flame, and in his right a plain straight short sword drawn and held low, a thin line of the same pale light along its edge. Feet set wide, a hard, unbending look, the mouth shut.
formal: On the day of the spring trials: the long garrison coat brushed clean, the town's small iron badge nailed on the chest, a clean white shirt collar showing, a thin cord tied around the left wrist, the keys and the brass steelyard at the belt, polished boots. He stands at attention with a ledger under one arm, a grave, plain look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the olive-green eyes looking straight at the viewer, tired and level, the mouth closed. Cold wet stone-grey light from one side, a warm orange glow of charcoal from below on the other. Foreground blur: the small brass steelyard and the warped shield buckle swinging from it. He wears the faded grey garrison coat.
battle_old: On the night of the water gate: the leather jerkin buckled tight under the grey garrison coat, leather bracers, the keys and the brass steelyard at the belt. In his left hand he holds up a blessed lamp, an iron-framed lantern with a clear pale white flame, and in his right a plain straight short sword drawn and held low. Feet set wide, a hard, unbending look, the mouth shut.
gear: 灵格｜中｜照常｜2档｜灵格的牢看守长，家境中等，定2；341年没有附魔铠甲，皮甲外头一副刻神名的铁胸甲和护喉，招牌是祝过的灯和秤。
faces_extra: The right eyebrow (on the viewer's left) is visibly cut in two by a short pale scar in every panel; the irises are clearly olive green, NOT brown.

name: 盖拉赫
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:2101
who: Gerlach, a fire-horned demon, head-man of the walled city of Ember Horn beyond the middle wall, about a hundred and forty years old and looking fifty-five or fifty-six: about 215 cm, a full two heads taller than those around him, massive and long-limbed. Charcoal-black skin with a faint ember glow in the creases. Ash-grey hair plaited in three strands and pressed flat at the nape. Molten-copper eyes. A pair of thick horns bending forward, only two dim embers on their tips at rest. From a hide cord at his belt hangs one old broken horn, an ancestor's, which he holds still with his hand as he walks so it does not knock. A measured, counting, heavy-hearted air of a leader who brings back fewer than he takes.
face: FACE, as in the references: a long, heavy, lined man's face of about fifty-five, NOT young: molten-copper eyes under thick ash-grey brows, deep lines across the brow and from the nose to the mouth, a heavy jaw, a firm closed mouth; charcoal-black skin with faint ember-red shadows; thick forward-bending horns with two dim embers on the tips.
build: 215 cm, massive and long-limbed: very broad shoulders, a deep chest, huge hands; he stands a full two heads above an ordinary man.
palette: charcoal black and molten copper, ash grey, ember orange, old horn ivory
casual: A head-man's dress in a stone-built demon city: a long sleeveless coat of dark scorched leather to the knee, its edges bound with iron, over a long-sleeved rust-red wool tunic, a broad belt with the old broken horn hanging from a hide cord at his left hip, heavy trousers and thick boots. His left hand rests on the broken horn to keep it still; in his right a folded, captured wall-army report. A heavy, counting look.
private: In his stone house at evening: the leather coat off, the rust-red wool tunic with the sleeves rolled, the belt with the broken horn, the trousers and soft boots, the plaits loosened. He stands holding a clay cup of water, a tired, thoughtful look.
battle: Leading the molten charge, in a fire-horn head-man's war harness: heavy plates of blackened iron and black obsidian over thick boiled leather across his chest and shoulders, the obsidian cut with old clan marks that glow ember red from within, iron-bound bracers banded with obsidian, the old broken horn at his left hip under his left hand. Both his horns blaze a fierce orange-white, molten orange dripping from the soles of his boots and trailing from his greaves, and in his right hand he grips a great blade of black obsidian whose edge glows like cooling lava. Head lowered, striding forward, a set, heavy, unflinching look.
formal: Presiding over the yearly offering at the city's fire pool: a long coat of dark rust-red wool to the ankles, closes down the front with iron toggles, fitted sleeves, a short mantle of scorched black fur, a heavy obsidian band around the base of each horn, the old broken horn on its cord at his left hip. He stands upright with his left hand on the broken horn, a grave, burdened look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the molten-copper eyes looking straight at the viewer, weary and immovable, the mouth closed. Deep orange light from below as if from a pool of fire, cold grey smoke-light from the other side. Foreground blur: drifting smoke and the cracked old horn at the edge of the frame. He wears the dark scorched leather coat.
battle_old: Leading the molten charge: heavy plates of blackened iron and thick boiled leather over his chest and shoulders, iron-bound bracers, the old broken horn still at his left hip under his left hand. Both his horns blaze a fierce orange-white, molten orange dripping from the soles of his boots, and in his right hand he grips a great blade of black obsidian. Head lowered, striding forward, a set, heavy, unflinching look.
gear: 英雄（约 LVL 172）｜中｜照常｜4档｜英雄定4，烬角城头人；700年炎角那一身黑铁加黑曜、刻着族纹的胸肩甲，招牌是黑曜大刃和祖上那只断角。

name: 戴德里克·灰秤
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_三_灯的年月.md:2121
who: Dederick Greyscale, a human inquisitor of the tribunal posted to the southern wall, forty-one years old: about 180 cm, lean and upright. Indigo hair combed straight back flat and smooth from the forehead and tied neatly at the nape, NOT loose or wavy. Honey-gold eyes that look first at a person's hands, then at the brow. His LEFT eyebrow (on the viewer's RIGHT when he faces us) is split by ONE short pale nick from a prisoner's shackle, no taller than the brow itself; it does NOT run down past the eye, NOT onto the cheek or nose. His right eyebrow (viewer's left) is unmarked. At his throat on a plain cord hangs a single old iron key, rusted solid. No other jewellery, no glasses. A severe, careful, self-distrusting air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, severe man's face of forty-one: honey-gold eyes under straight indigo brows, the left brow (viewer's RIGHT) split by ONE short pale nick no taller than the brow itself; it does NOT run down past the eye, NOT onto the cheek or nose; faint lines at the eye corners and between the brows; a narrow straight nose; a thin, closed mouth; clean-shaven. Skin shadows a cool, pale tone.
build: 180 cm, lean and upright: narrow shoulders held square, long arms, long hands.
palette: tribunal grey and indigo, honey gold, rust brown, parchment white
casual: His inquisitor's dress: a long grey robe of the tribunal that closes down the front with buttons right up to the collar, fitted sleeves, a narrow black belt, dark trousers and plain boots; the rusted old key on its cord at his throat, outside the robe. He holds a sheaf of trial rolls against his chest with one hand. A cool, measuring look, the mouth closed.
private: Late at night in the prison stairwell: the grey robe unbuttoned at the throat, a plain long-sleeved white linen shirt under it, the key on its cord, the boots. He holds a small coal scuttle of charcoal in one hand, a tired, private look.
battle: He is no fighter: the grey tribunal robe buttoned to the throat, a long dark grey wool cloak over it, a plain sheathed short sword hanging unused at his left hip, the rusted key at his throat. He holds the trial roster open in front of him in both hands, reading from it; a cold, steady look, the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, standing upright and still with the trial roster held open in both hands before him, the feet together; a cold, steady look, the mouth closed.
formal: Presiding at the spring trial: a long formal grey tribunal robe to the ankles with a high standing collar, closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a pale grey sash and a small round iron badge of the tribunal on the chest, plain geometric rings, NOT a cross, no cross shapes, the rusted key on its cord at his throat. He holds a quill in his right hand and the roster in his left. He stands very straight, a grave, unreadable look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the honey-gold eyes looking straight at the viewer, a severe, searching look, the mouth closed. Pale white lamplight from one side, cold blue-grey stone-dark on the other. Foreground blur: the rusted old key on its cord and the edge of a roll of names. He wears the grey tribunal robe buttoned to the collar.
battle_old: He is no fighter: the grey tribunal robe buttoned to the throat, a long dark grey wool cloak over it, a plain sheathed short sword hanging unused at his left hip, the rusted key at his throat. He holds the trial roster open in front of him in both hands, reading from it; a cold, steady look, the mouth closed.
gear: 灵格｜中｜不打仗｜2档｜审判官不出手，第三格照姿势句捧名册；剑挂着不用，照原句交回。
faces_extra: In all nine heads the scar is only ONE short pale nick through the left eyebrow (viewer's right), no longer than the brow is tall, never a long slash across the eye or cheek; the indigo hair is combed straight back flat and tied at the nape.
